Message.Name: Seconds Message
Message.Description: This message is sent every second for which at least one message is being generated. The message contains the number of seconds since the start of 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, also called Unix Time

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: Unix time (number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Message.Name: Order Book Directory
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Order book directory messages are disseminated for all active securities, including halted securities, in the Genium INET Trading system. Intra-day transmissions of this message may occur when new order books are added to the system; updates to existing order books may also be represented by intra-day Order book Directory messages

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book. NOTE: Expired Order book IDs may be reused for new instruments

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security short name

Field.Name: Long Name
Field.Description: Human-readable long name of security

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN code identifying security

Field.Name: Financial Product
Field.Description: Financial product of the order book

Field.Name: Trading Currency
Field.Description: Trading currency

Field.Name: Number Of Decimals In Price
Field.Description: This value defines the number of decimals used in price for this order book. NOTE: A value of 256 means that the instrument is traded in fractions (each fraction is 1/256)

Field.Name: Number Of Decimals In Nominal Value
Field.Description: This value defines the number of decimals in Nominal Value

Field.Name: Odd Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represent an odd lot for the order book. NOTE: A value of 0 indicates that this lot type is undefined for the order book

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the quantity that represents a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Block Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represents an odd lot for the order book (the document repeats the Odd Lot Size wording for this block lot field). NOTE: A value of 0 indicates that this lot type is undefined for the order book

Field.Name: Nominal Value
Field.Description: Nominal value

Message.Name: Combination Order Book Directory
Message.Description: Specialized directory message used when Combination order books are traded in the marketplace. It represents both standard combinations defined by the exchange and tailor-made combinations created by members. Intra-day transmissions may occur when new combination order books are added, typically for tailor-made combinations

Message.Name: Tick Size Table Entry
Message.Description: Contains information on a tick size for a price range. Together, all Tick Size messages with the same order book ID form a complete Tick Size Table. The number of decimals in prices are given by the Order Book Directory message for this order book

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: The order book to which this entry belongs

Field.Name: Tick Size
Field.Description: Tick Size for the given price range

Field.Name: Price From
Field.Description: Start of price range for this entry

Field.Name: Price To
Field.Description: End of price range for this entry. Zero (0) means infinity

Message.Name: Order Book State Message
Message.Description: The Order book state message relays information on state changes

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: State Name
Field.Description: Name of Order Book State

Message.Name: Add Order No MPID Attribution
Message.Description: Add Order Message. Indicates that a new order has been accepted by the Genium INET Trading system and was added to the displayable book. Generated for unattributed orders

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the new order. NOTE: The number is only unique per Order book and side

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order. Values: B = buy order, S = sell order

Field.Name: Order Book Position
Field.Description: Rank within order book. See Appendix A, How to Build an Order Book View

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The visible quantity of the order. NOTE: Orders with an undisclosed quantity will have this field set to 0

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order. See Data Types for field processing notes

Field.Name: Exchange Order Type
Field.Description: Additional order attributes. Values: 0 = Not applicable, 1 = Force, 2 = Short Sell, 4 = Market Bid, 8 = Price Stabilization, 16 = Override Crossing, 32 = Undisclosed, 1024 = Fill-and-kill immediately, 2048 = Firm color disabled, 4096 = Convert to aggressive (if locked market). NOTE: Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace. NOTE: This field is a bit map. Multiple values may be set simultaneously

Field.Name: Lot Type
Field.Description: Lot Type. Values: 0 = Undefined, 1 = Odd Lot, 2 = Round Lot, 3 = Block Lot, 4 = All or None Lot

Message.Name: End Of Snapshot Message
Message.Description: Returns the current ITCH sequence number to be used when connecting to the ITCH feed. To maintain a real-time order display, firms should begin to process real-time Genium INET ITCH messages beginning with the sequence number stated in this snapshot message + 1

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Genium INET ITCH SoupBinTCP sequence number when the snapshot was taken. To be used when logging in to the SoupBinTCP ITCH feed. NOTE: While GLIMPSE is a binary feed, the SoupBinTCP uses ASCII characters to represent the sequence number

Bitfield.Name: Exchange Order Type
Bitfield.Description: Additional order attributes. Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace. The field is a bit map, multiple values may be set simultaneously; 0 = Not applicable

Field.Name: Force
Field.Description: Force (value 1)

Field.Name: Short Sell
Field.Description: Short Sell (value 2)

Field.Name: Market Bid
Field.Description: Market Bid (value 4)

Field.Name: Price Stabilization
Field.Description: Price Stabilization (value 8)

Field.Name: Override Crossing
Field.Description: Override Crossing (value 16)

Field.Name: Undisclosed
Field.Description: Undisclosed (value 32)

Field.Name: Reserved Bits 7 To 10
Field.Description: Reserved, values 64 through 512 are not stated

Field.Name: Fill And Kill Immediately
Field.Description: Fill-and-kill immediately (value 1024)

Field.Name: Firm Color Disabled
Field.Description: Firm color disabled (value 2048)

Field.Name: Convert To Aggressive
Field.Description: Convert to aggressive, if locked market (value 4096)

Field.Name: Reserved Bits 14 To 16
Field.Description: Reserved, values 8192 and above are not stated
